36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
126975: A newbie red blood cell, who has a bad sense of direction.
126981: He is a White Blood Cell, specifically a Neutrophil, working under the Neutrophil Division. Along with the other neutrophil comrades, he's tasked to patrol around the Blood Vessel and remove any invading Foreign Substances such as Germs and Viruses.
127041: A type of White Blood Cell. Said to comprise only a small percent of all White Blood Cells. Multiplies during allergic reactions or parasitic infections. Though weak, Eosinophils are capable of phagocytosis, just like other White Blood Cells.
127070: Her kind plays many roles in the body, from nursery school teachers to professional killers. Therefore, she bears many faces and personalities depending on which role she is playing.
127071: A T-cell who leads his own squad in exterminating pathogens.
127417: Platelet is a type of cell working under the Platelet Division. She and her coworkers are responsible for reconstructing injuries and forming blood clots in the human body. Due to the Platelet's actual cell size, they are depicted as children.
132613: She is a white blood cell, specifically a Mast Cell (mastocyte or labrocyte). As a part of the immune system, she releases chemicals such as histamines and leukotrienes as a stimulus to excess production of IgE (Immunoglobulin E, an antibody produced by B Cells).
132614: He is a Neutrophil working under the Neutrophil Division and a close friend of U-1146, along with U-2001, U-2626 and U-2048. As a neutrophil, his purpose is to destroy bacteria invading the body.
132615: He was born mutated because the normal cell who grew him made a copying error in his DNA. His mutation causes him to appear different from normal cells and to replicate uncontrollably, causing potentially deadly cancer.
132616: He is a bacteria that causes illnesses such as pneumonia and pneumococcal bacteremia.
132617: Memory Cell is a Lymphocyte that retains memories of a pathogen. They're prepared for for a second invasion by the same bacteria or virus.
132618: A type of T Cell that determines strategy and course of action for dealing with foreign invaders. He's the main commander of the Killer T Cells and has an intellectual disposition. He and Killer T Cell do not get along well, despite having gone through T Cell training together
132619: She is a new red blood cell and AE3803's junior. She is introduced to AE3803 by AA5100. Despite her lack of work experience, she is well educated with the cells and body. She and AE3803 do not get along well initially due to their different personalities.
132620: She is a type of bacteria that lives on the skin who can cause skin infections, pneumonia, meningitis, septicemia and food poisoning if ingested.
132621: The role of Dendritic Cells is to present bacteria that have invaded the body, and fragments of viral infected cells as antigens an to notify other immune cells. As their name implies, they feature protrusions. Dendritic Cells can activate Naive T-Cells.
132622: A mysterious and poetic character whose real occupation is unknown, appearing during a parasitic infection to make cryptic commentaries on the events unfolding.
132623: She is a white blood cell, specifically a Lymphocyte (Natural Killer Cell). She is tasked to identify, track, and kill viruses and infected cells by moving freely from tissue to tissue.
132624: Regulatory T Cell is a type of White Blood Cell, specifically a T-Lymphocyte. Regulatory T Cell regulates the activity of all T Cells so they don't attack cells from the same body.
132625: She is a older red blood cell with decent working experience in the blood vessels. She sometimes guides and teaches AE3803 how to do her job when she is confused or lost.
132626: As Naive T Cell, he has a blonde forelock of hair that's just barely visible under his hat, but as Effector T Cell it grows significantly and sticks straight up. His effector T form is heavily referenced from the various protagonists from Jojo's Bizarre Adventure.
132627: He is a white blood cell, specifically a T Lymphocyte (Memory T Cell) that works under the Killer T Division. He is tasked with storing information about any foreign entities and cells that have invaded the body before.
156657: As a rookie, he was initially excited for his task of going to the lungs, only to find LDL's, Carbon Monoxide, and Pneumococcus along the way.
156658: She is very set on her mission and never complains about the hardships of working in the bad work conditions or the poor treatment they receive, but still appreciates support and shows respect to other cells.
202982: A close friend of AA2153, they faced certain challenges together as newbies in the horrifying situation of the body they work in. Unlike his friend, he often runs away from these situations, to put his mind at ease, but is encouraged by AA2153 to work and push forward together.
215767: A captain White Blood Cell and the mentor of U-1196.
